Mod.Name: Nitpick
Mod.Description: This mod gives you access to some niche options and fixes a few minor details. This includes the fixed backgrounds for Seventh Heaven bar sign, Midgar 5 truck label, Sector 5 gate number, Corel Prison sign, black materia shape, Red XIII's portrait etc. It also offers a range of add-ons, including the option to change the background on the title screen and on the credits screen, a disc change screen homage. Listen to music during the title screen and more! Additional Authors: Aavock, Cae Lumen, Satsuki, L@zar0, Dangarfield, Kaldarasha, Grimmy, Jusete
